extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, industry stakeholders, and transportation/aviation professionals monitoring DOT/Federal Aviation Administration proposed rules and preparing comments
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable listing of Department of Transportation proposed rules (Federal Register API results) used to find, review, and prepare notice-and-comment responses to specific NPRMs and corrections. The page aggregates short abstracts and links for many FAA/Pipeline/FMCSA proposed rules and related procedural actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish RNAV Route Q-855 and Revoke Jet Route J-549
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to establish Canadian Area Navigation (RNAV) Route Q-855 and revoke Jet Route J-549 in the vicinity of Williston, North Dakota.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: provide enroute continuity with NAV Canada's ongoing route structure modernization efforts. (Actionable change: establish a new RNAV route and revoke an existing jet route; impacts enroute charting/navigation.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish RNAV Route Q-838 and Revoke Jet Route J-539
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to establish Canadian Area Navigation (RNAV) Route Q-838 and revoke Jet Route J-539 in the vicinity of Glasgow, MT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: provide enroute continuity with NAV Canada's ongoing route structure modernization efforts. (Actionable change to airway structure.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise Rotorcraft Flight Manual for Guimbal Cabri G2 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain Hélicoptères Guimbal (HG) Model Cabri G2 helicopters that would require revising the existing rotorcraft flight manual (RFM) for the helicopter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: prompted by a report of a potential malfunction of the helicopter emergency locator transmitter (ELT) and findings of weak ELT signals due to improper antenna installation (location). Purpose: address the unsafe condition on these products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repetitive Inspections and Corrective Actions for Airbus A330 Lavatory Floor Fittings (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require repetitive inspections of the affected lavatory floor fittings and applicable corrective actions and would allow replacement of each affected floor fitting as an optional terminating action; it would also limit or prohibit installation of affected parts under certain conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: prompted by reports of corrosion on lavatory floor fittings. Purpose: address the unsafe condition; inspections may be repetitive and replacement may be permitted as terminating action; installation restrictions apply for certain airplanes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise Airworthiness Limitations / Maintenance Programs for Airbus Helicopters EC155 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require revising the airworthiness limitations section (ALS) of the existing maintenance manual (MM) or instructions for continued airworthiness and the existing approved maintenance or inspection program, as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: determination that new or more restrictive airworthiness limitations are necessary. Purpose: address the unsafe condition on these products by updating maintenance/inspection requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amend Class D and Class E Airspace Over New Bedford, MA
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to amend Class D and Class E airspace over New Bedford, MA, adding a 0.7 mile long, 3.6-mile-wide extension to properly contain current IFR operations, updating airport name and geographic coordinates, and replacing 'Airport/Facility Directory' with 'Chart Supplement' in legal description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actionable changes: modify airspace boundaries and legal descriptions to conform with current IFR operations and FAA guidance. Implication: affects controlled airspace and chart/legal text for procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process and Requirements for Unmanned Aircraft Flight Restrictions (UAFR)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposal would implement a process for operators and proprietors of certain fixed site facilities to request and maintain an unmanned aircraft flight restriction (UAFR) and establishes requirements for applicants to demonstrate the UAFR is necessary for aviation safety, protection of people/property, national security, or homeland security; it also identifies types of allowed operations within a UAFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statutory implementation (sec. 2209 FAA Extension, Safety and Security Act of 2016). Applicants must demonstrate specified public-interest or safety/security justifications; the rule will define allowed versus prohibited operations and the administrative process to request/maintain a restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct Monetary Thresholds for OPID Notifications for Construction
rubrics_metrics.description: This document corrects the preamble and amendatory regulatory text within a proposed rule regarding monetary thresholds for certain gas pipeline facility construction notifications to match intended values referenced elsewhere in the preamble.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a correction to prior NPRM text—procedural/technical correction to regulatory thresholds. Stakeholders should note corrected thresholds for applicability of notification requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersede AD 2023-21-10: Expand Inspections for ATR Airplanes (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would supersede AD 2023-21-10, continue required inspections of horizontal stabilizer components and require inspecting additional areas (HS front spar web and center box internal area) and expand applicability to additional airplanes, with applicable corrective actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: determination that additional airplanes are affected and additional areas must be inspected. Action: expanded inspection scope, expanded applicability, and on-condition corrective actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rototest Inspection of Bulk Cargo Door Corners on Airbus A320/A321 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require a rototest inspection for cracks in the forward and aft upper corner of the bulk cargo door and applicable on-condition actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: fatigue test identified cracks. Action: mandated inspection method (rototest) and required corrective actions if cracks found.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspections, Functional Checks, and Maintenance Manual Revisions for GE CF34 Engines (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require performing restart tests, borescope inspections of the HPC case for corrosion, VG system functional checks for pressure evaluation, force gage test on feedback cable, visual inspection of the VG system for obstruction, and, depending on results, removal of the engine from service; it would also require revising the ALS of the engine maintenance manual to incorporate the VG system functional check.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: prompted by a dual engine power loss event revealing corrosion in the HPC case affecting the VG system. Actions include a sequence of tests and inspections, conditional corrective actions (including removal from service), and a revision to ALS to institutionalize the functional check.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extend Comment Period for Unified Carrier Registration Fees NPRM
rubrics_metrics.description: FMCSA is extending the comment period for its NPRM titled 'Fees for the Unified Carrier Registration Plan and Agreement' to provide opportunity for the public to access supporting documentation regarding fee calculations for the 2027 registration year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural change: extension of comment deadline (from May 7 to May 26, 2026). Rationale: requested by Small Business in Transportation Coalition (SBTC); stakeholders may require extra time to review supporting fee-calculation documents before commenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspect Fuselage Reinforcing Repairs on Boeing 757 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require inspection for any existing reinforcing repairs in specified fuselage frame lower lobe areas and applicable on-condition actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: reports of crack damage at existing reinforcing repairs. Action: mandated inspections and corrective measures to address unsafe condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish Prohibited Area P-75 (New York) to Restrict Aircraft Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to establish Prohibited Area 75 (P-75) in the vicinity of the New York, NY, residence of the President of the United States to restrict aircraft operations requested by the United States Secret Service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: provide adequate safeguards and national security protections for USSS protectees and to fully secure non-Governmental property. Action: creation of prohibited airspace with attendant restrictions on aircraft operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: GVI of Slat 2 Cove Rib 6 Bracket Fasteners on Bombardier BD-700 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require a general visual inspection (GVI) of affected fasteners on slat 2 cove rib 6 brackets to determine if all fasteners are installed and applicable on-condition actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: reports of missing or under torqued fasteners. Action: GVI and required corrective actions if discrepancies found.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove Class E4 and Amend Class D Airspace Over Nashua, NH
rubrics_metrics.description: This action proposes to amend Class D airspace and remove Class E4 airspace over Nashua, NH because the Class E4 is no longer needed to contain IFR operations; also proposes to replace 'Notice to Air Missions' with 'Notice to Airmen' in legal description to comply with FAA guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Action: adjust controlled airspace designations and legal text to reflect current operational needs and terminology guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise Airworthiness Limitations and Approved Maintenance Program for Textron Model 408 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require revising the Airworthiness Limitations Section (ALS) of the existing aircraft maintenance manual (AMM) or instructions for continued airworthiness (ICA) and the existing approved maintenance or inspection program, as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: manufacturer's revision to add detailed inspection and change serial effectivity. Purpose: ensure required inspections and maintenance are mandatory to address unsafe condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue and Expand Requirements of AD 2025-16-12 for Airbus A319/A320/A321 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would continue actions required by AD 2025-16-12 (revise AFM and MEL, allow replacement of affected high-pressure bleed valve (HPV) as optional terminating action, prohibit installation of affected parts) and would require repetitive replacement of each affected HPV clip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: need for repetitive replacement of HPV clips to address unsafe condition. Action: continued AFM/MEL revisions plus new repetitive replacement requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repetitive Inspection and Replacement of Ejector Ducts on Leonardo AW189 (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require repetitively inspecting left- and right-hand ejector ducts (including exhaust bracket reinforcements and reinforcement plates) and, depending on results, replacing any affected ejector duct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: reports of cracking on ejector ducts. Action: recurring inspections and replacement as necessary to address unsafe condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise AFM-S to Limit ETOPS-180 Operations for Certain A330 Aircraft (AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: This proposed AD would require revising the existing Airplane Flight Manual Supplement (AFM-S) to limit ETOPS-180 operations to three flightcrew members, as applicable, and correct minimum oxygen dispatch pressure information for airplanes with a flightcrew oxygen system supplied by a single oxygen cylinder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason: finding that oxygen supply would be insufficient under ETOPS-180 with four flightcrew members. Action: AFM-S revision to limit crew complement for ETOPS-180 and correct dispatch pressure info to mitigate unsafe condition.
